tour.thanksBody: Tank you say you do di tour! Share route, explore wetin dey around you, and you fit come back to di guide anytime from your profile.
tour.welcomeBody: Small guided waka around di app. Follow di glow — you fit tap di highlighted controls as we dey go. You hold di wheel anytime with Back, Next, or Skip.
tour.shareBody: Drop full journey with stops, fares, and vehicle details. Try tap am — di composer go open sharp sharp.
tour.exploreBody: Di live map dey show community routes and places. "Near me" go focus di results for your location — try am.
tour.profileBody: Connected accounts, points, email & security, and privacy controls dey inside dis account tab group. Your transport posts dey under am.
tour.notificationsBody: In-app notifications dey mirror to push and email where dem wire am, so you go hear about responses, rewards, and requests anywhere you dey.
tour.authLoginBody: Use email and password, continue with Google, or keep browsing as guest. Signing in go unlock posting, bookmarks, and notifications.
tour.authRegisterBody: Name, username, email, and password na all you need. We go send 6-digit code make we verify your email before your first post.
tour.composerLocationsBody: Type place, address, landmark, coordinates, or plus code — suggestions go show as you type. Every stop dey use di same field, so you fit build di whole journey.
tour.composerLocateBody: Dis one go fill a stop with your live position — e good for di origin. You fit also pick suggestion from di dropdown or place di stop for map.
tour.composerFindMapBody: Open di preview come tap di exact point to set dis stop. Di map dey show live tracing and traffic for di whole route as you dey build am.
tour.composerScoreBody: Route Quality Score dey grow with clear locations, fares, vehicle details, and helpful description. Higher score go earn trust badges and better reach.
tour.postOverviewBody: Every route card dey show who share am, di stops in order, fares, and vehicle chips. Open di title make you see full route, photos, comments, and di map.
tour.postTrustBody: Di trust badge na di route community-verified score. Hover or tap am make you see di breakdown: community votes, route detail, corroboration, recency, and engagement.
tour.postActionsBody: Likes and useful comments dey support route validity, while dislikes and reports dey pull am down. Correct routes dey climb di feed come earn stronger trust badges.
tour.postNavigateBody: Tap Navigate make e open di live guide — turn-by-turn stops, map tracing, distance, time, and fare. Di tour go wait while you look around, den you fit continue.
tour.routeRequestBody: You no see journey? Tap Request come talk where you dey go from and to, plus details like budget, time of day, or luggage. Community go reply with full routes.
tour.resumeMessage: Your platform tour pause — you wan continue from where you stop?
